changelog: The hand-off strip above the sales and admin boards shows each person's load under their name: "{n} open" for everyone and "· {m} overdue follow-ups" for admins and the dispatcher only (`GET /api/sales/team` now returns `open` and `overdue`, the latter null unless `canSeeRepOverdue`) — the same counts and the same visibility rule as the team page (#3875).

en: Board: the colleagues strip now shows how many open leads each person has; admins also see their overdue follow-ups.
tr: Pano: ekip arkadaşları şeridi artık her kişinin kaç açık lead'i olduğunu gösteriyor; yöneticiler gecikmiş takipleri de görüyor.
de: Board: Die Kollegenleiste zeigt jetzt, wie viele offene Leads jede Person hat; Admins sehen auch überfällige Wiedervorlagen.
